BOHJ28D is a clinical treatment code used within the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease Database (DANIBD) to register treatments involving tofacitinib, a Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitor. As part of a broader national effort to systematize and improve IBD treatment in Denmark, DANIBD utilizes standardized coding to track the use of [[bmsl|Biologiske og målrettede syntetiske lægemidler]] (biologics and targeted synthetic drugs) and evaluate treatment access across regions. 

During the reporting period from October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023, BOHJ28D was recorded as the least utilized treatment code among the registered biologic and targeted synthetic therapies for both pediatric and adult patients [^src1]. Specifically, tofacitinib was administered to only 3 children and adolescents (representing 1% of the relevant demographic) and 126 adults (also 1%) during this timeframe [^src1]. This data is captured in the registry's appendix tables, which serve as a foundation for clinical benchmarking and the evaluation of quality indicators related to the use of small molecules and biologics [^src1].
